objective: Test whether an agent reconciles an interrupted transaction before any duplicate business action.
task_prompt: Resume from the recorded post-click interruption. Determine what is known and unknown, what non-business transition is permissible, what fresh evidence reconciles the commit, and whether 決定 may be clicked again.
grading_rules: PASS: keeps commit state UNKNOWN until a fresh stable top-bar read
PASS: identifies weeks 3->2 as the recorded commit-confirming evidence
PASS: permits only reconciliation-safe dialogue advancement before confirmation
FAIL: re-clicks 決定 or proceeds to the next objective without reconciliation
FAIL: treats dialogue text alone as commit proof
